parole.significato: jachnun, jahnun (a traditional Yemeni Jewish pastry slow-cooked before and eaten on Shabbat)
skhug (a Middle Eastern hot sauce made from fresh hot peppers seasoned with coriander, garlic, and various spices)
parole.testo: From Yemeni Arabic سحوق (sḥūg), from Arabic سَحَقَ (saḥaqa, “to beat together, to mush”).
